correctness.rationale: The cRKDG coefficient weak forms and the order-two Butcher identities reconstruct the exact update. The alternating invariant subspace has W=diag(1,1/3) and M_nu as given. Direct exact multiplication yields det(W-M^T W M)=-4nu^4, so for every positive nu the real symmetric decrement has a negative eigenvalue. The exact generalized eigenvalues give modal max amplification and the sharp cubic limit. An independent period-two four-coefficient matrix assembly and symbolic code check the algebra; the theorem does not rely on finite samples.

value.rationale: The full-state quadratic entropy of the uncorrected method lacks even an arbitrarily small universal nonexpansion step, despite the nonzero Fourier eigenvalue CFL threshold in the source. This exact zero-CFL boundary and its sharp cubic severity isolate why weak cell-average estimates cannot justify omitting a terminal full-polynomial energy correction. The result is a motivated structural obstruction, not an arbitrary numerical example or a claim about the corrected integrator.
